quest.title: Every Day a New Adventure
quest.description: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild seems to have a new commission for you.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Adventurer's Experience x2

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: We meet again, avid adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Are your adventures going smoothly?

choices.text: I'm like a well-oiled adventuring machine.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: That is the spirit. Keep it up!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: It seems that you have a wealth of experience under your belt now. Time to introduce you to the formal work of the Guild.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The Guild receives requests from far and wide each day, and assigns <color=#00E1FFFF>commissions</color> to adventurers accordingly.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: These commissioned adventures are the main source of compensation for our guild members.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of commissions are they?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: It is a mixed bag! Anything from running an errand for fellow citizens to dealing with monsters. Some are textbook, others are extremely dangerous.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: But you do not have to take my word for it. You should find out for yourself.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Here you can find the details of today's commissions.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Please report back to me upon completion. There will be a generous reward waiting for you.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: #Excellent. I knew I could count on you, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: #I await your return with great anticipation, {NICKNAME}. Ad astra abyssosque!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Patience is a virtue! You will find out soon enough. I am sure you will not be disappointed.

choices.text: Actually, adventuring is quite taxing work.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: It is always that way when you are starting out. Preparing properly before an adventure can help things go more smoothly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Claim Daily Commission Reward</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Thank you for completing today's commissions. Here is your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you shouldn't have! Except, you totally should.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: This is a token of the Guild's gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: We receive many new commissions every day, and without the efforts of each and every adventurer there is no way we could respond to them all.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: If you complete enough commissions each day, you will be eligible to claim a special reward from me.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Your Adventurer Handbook keeps a record of how many adventures you complete each day.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Make sure you claim your daily rewards on the days that you complete sufficient adventures. There is a limited quantity of rewards, so it will become forfeit should you not claim it.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: You're more than welcome. After all, you are the one helping me.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: And please note that helping a fellow adventurer to complete a commission also counts towards your eligibility for a daily reward.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: We encourage you to work actively with your fellow adventurers. Ad astra abyssosque!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: As things currently stand, yes... My apologies.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: But please be assured that we are constantly pushing Headquarters to make sure all our adventurers receive fair and adequate compensation.

talks.objective: Complete 4 Daily Commissions then talk to Katheryne

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: #You did a fine job, {NICKNAME}! Outstanding performance, considering it was your first time.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: The requester even asked me to thank you on their behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: And, as promised, you are due your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: #I heard something through the grape vine, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Word has it that you completed a <color=#00E1FFFF>commission</color>. The requester sends their thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: What commission? Refresh my memory.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You helped someone in need while you were out on the road.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: In fact many of those you will meet have commissioned the Guild to assist.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Let me explain the Guild's system to you in a little more detail.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: The Guild receives requests from far and wide each day, and assigns commissions to adventurers accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: These commissioned adventures are the main source of compensation for our guild members.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: On the subject of compensation, I should mention that the Guild has prepared a little something for you.
